articles.title: The public school system has failed American kids. Now what?

During passing periods, I'd hurry as fast as I could to avoid being 'jumped.' I'd walk down the hallways seeing fights break out with alarms blaring and the school's lone police officer running through masses of pupils after a kid had been beaten up. It's impossible to learn when you're constantly in survival mode."
